nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Nexscope Product Database multi-condition filtering. Filter Amazon products by category, price, sales volume, revenue, reviews, rating, weight, BSR rank, LQS, seller type, and more across 10 marketplaces. Trigger when users mention Amazon product selection, product database filtering, BSR rank filtering, category-based product discovery, high-rating low-competition products, FBA product search, Amazon product discovery, or similar terms. Even if the user does not explicitly mention "Nexscope" or "product database," trigger this skill whenever the request involves filtering Amazon products by multiple criteria or discovering potential products.

categories.description: Primary category names, comma-separated, must match the standard category names for the corresponding site. US site examples: Appliances, Arts Crafts & Sewing, Automotive, Baby, Beauty & Personal Care, Books, CDs & Vinyl, Cell Phones & Accessories, Clothing Shoes & Jewelry, Collectibles & Fine Art, Computers, Digital Music, Electronics, Garden & Outdoor, Grocery & Gourmet Food, Handmade, Health Household & Baby Care, Home & Kitchen, Industrial & Scientific, Kindle Store, Kitchen & Dining, Movies & TV, Musical Instruments, Office Products, Pet Supplies, Sports & Outdoors, Tools & Home Improvement, Toys & Games, Video Games, etc. Other sites (uk, de, fr, it, es, mx, jp, ca, in) have their own localized category names

excludeKeywords.description: Keywords to exclude from title/ASIN, comma-separated, up to 100 items, max 50 chars each

includeKeywords.description: Keywords to include in title/ASIN, comma-separated, up to 100 items, max 50 chars each

marketplace.description: Target marketplace code. Options: us, uk, de, in, ca, fr, it, es, mx, jp

needCount.description: Total number of results to return, API auto-paginates internally

productTiers.description: Product size tiers, comma-separated. Options: oversize, standard

sellerTypes.description: Seller types, comma-separated. Options: amz (Amazon self-operated), fba, fbm

sort.description: Sort field. Options: name, -name, category, -category, revenue, -revenue, sales, -sales, price, -price, rank, -rank, reviews, -reviews, lqs, -lqs, sellers, -sellers. Prefix - indicates descending. Default: name

name: nexscope_amazon_product_database
title: Amazon Product Database
